desc:
Imagine Mystia defeating you and she just goes: **NEVER GONNA GIVE YOU-**

Actually, what would be a Gensōkyō twist to this? 🤔

Reference – [***Phantasmagoria of Flower View*, Mystia's Win Dialogues.**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Phantasmagoria_of_Flower_View/Story/Mystia's_Script)

And yeah. For the Komachi one, there's no way she's singing "I of the Sanzu" or whatever. I've looked up the original song. The "Watashi" here is definitely not 私 that means "me," but rather 渡し that means "**ferry**." The "Yagiri no Watashi" is a famous 400-year-old Edo River ferry.
